commands.title: Keep awake state
commands.description: Whether the Mac is kept awake and why: {on, armed, text, detail, mode, hours, until, value, holds: [{kind, title, trailing, id?, session?, workspace?}], labels, laptop, onBattery, battery, display, lid}. mode is the user's one choice (hours, agents, on, or empty = off); holds are the lines under the status; labels holds every word of the switch. Every change publishes awake.changed with the same shape. Show every string as it is.

on.description: The Mac is kept awake now.

armed.description: While agents work is chosen and holds nothing yet.

text.description: What to show while on, e.g. Awake until 18:00; empty otherwise.

detail.description: One sentence: what holds it, power, lid.

hours.description: The chosen hours while mode is hours.

until.description: Unix seconds when the hours end; 0 otherwise.

value.description: The choice in words: Off, Until 18:00, While agents work, Until turned off.

session.description: The agent session that holds it.

onBattery.description: The Mac runs on battery now.

battery.description: While agents work holds on battery too.

lid.description: A laptop stays awake with the lid closed while it is kept awake.

commands.title: Set keep awake
commands.description: Set the user's one keep-awake choice: mode hours (with hours 1, 2, 4, 8 or 24), agents (while agents work), on (until turned off) or off. Returns the state as awake.state does.

hours.description: How many hours, with mode hours.

commands.title: Keep Mac Awake Until Turned Off
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake until you turn it off.

commands.title: Turn Off Keep Awake
commands.description: End your keep-awake choice; agents' own holds stay.

commands.title: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake while any agent session is running or waiting for you.

commands.title: Toggle Keep Awake
commands.description: Nothing chosen: keep awake until turned off; anything chosen: turn it off. Returns the state.

commands.title: Hold the Mac awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for a long build or run, then release it with awake.release. The hold ends by itself after minutes (default 60, at most 720), when the process pid exits, or when your session closes. Returns {hold, until}.

reason.description: What runs, shown to the user, e.g. release build.

pid.description: End the hold when this process exits.

until.description: Unix seconds when it ends at the latest.

commands.title: Release the Mac
commands.description: End a hold made with awake.hold.

commands.title: Set keep awake settings
commands.description: Change the keep-awake settings; returns the state as awake.state does.

battery.description: While agents work holds on battery too.

lid.description: Keep a laptop awake with the lid closed while it is kept awake (on battery until 10 % is left).
